name: Hamza Tahir
headline: CTO at ZenML, building Kitaru — open-source infrastructure for autonomous agents.
summary:
Hello, I'm Hamza, a co-founder at ZenML, an open-source MLOps framework to create reproducible machine learning pipelines. I have over 8 years of experience in developing and deploying data-driven products, using various tools and technologies such as GCP, AWS, TFX, Tensorflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, and FastAPI. 

My passion is to bridge the gap between machine learning development and production, and to empower data scientists to create ML workflows that can be easily scaled, monitored, and maintained. I also enjoy writing and sharing my knowledge and insights with the ML community, as evidenced by my publications on the Tensorflow blog and other platforms. If you're interested in learning more about ZenML, or want to connect with me about MLOps and data science, feel free to reach out to me. I'd love to hear from you.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: ZenML is an open-source MLOps framework to create reproducible Machine Learning pipelines.  A reoccurring struggle in machine learning is the large gap between the training part of the ML development and the post-training/deployment phase. ZenML aims to bridge that gap, by building a simple, open-source, pipeline framework aimed towards data scientists to create ML workflows that can be taken to production with minimum effort.

company.name: ZenML
company.tagline:
#Opensource #MLOps #Framework that integrates all your ML tools.
Run ML pipelines on any stack with minimum effort!
company.description: ZenML is an extensible, open-source MLOps framework for creating portable, production-ready MLOps pipelines. It's built for data scientists, ML Engineers, and MLOps Developers to collaborate as they develop to production. ZenML has simple, flexible syntax, is cloud- and tool-agnostic, and has interfaces/abstractions that are catered towards ML workflows. ZenML brings together all your favorite tools in one place so you can tailor your workflow to cater to your needs.
